aboutText: I am Oumarou Billy, a Master’s student in Artificial Intelligence and a fullstack developer. I build complete applications from backend architecture to high-fidelity frontend interfaces, while continuously advancing my applied AI research. My goal is to build reliable, scalable, and impactful solutions aligned with modern tech demands.

servicesList.title: Fullstack Web Architecture & Engineering
servicesList.description: End-to-end design and engineering of modern, scalable web applications (Next.js, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL) pairing refined user interfaces with high SSR/SSG performance.

servicesList.title: Scalable REST APIs & Backend Architectures
servicesList.description: Engineering robust backend architectures, microservices, secure JWT authentication, relational (PostgreSQL) / NoSQL data modeling, and serverless cloud workflows (AWS Lambda, S3).

servicesList.title: Applied AI Engineering, NLP & Computer Vision
servicesList.description: Training and operationalizing machine learning and deep learning models (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn): semantic document processing (NLP), facial emotion recognition (Computer Vision), and predictive pipelines.

servicesList.title: Performance Optimization, Luxury UI/UX & Mobile Solutions
servicesList.description: Core Web Vitals auditing, high-fidelity responsive ergonomics (Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion), cross-platform mobile apps (Flutter / Dart), and decentralized traceability (Blockchain / Web3).
